criteria.title: Question & dataset fit
criteria.description: A real engineering question is stated, and the chosen dataset can actually answer it. Provenance and licence stated. Assess the written justification and interpretation for this criterion. Numerical checks are scored separately. Do not infer correct code execution from prose. Unverifiable visual, repository-history or model-fitting claims must be flagged as concerns, not awarded as established facts.
